purpose: Production cloud profile (D1 condition met) and CLI upgrade from an earlier wrapper.

edits.why: D1: the hosted service is approved and live, so the build uses the reviewed production API (base URL and account issuer).
Shared conversation links use the production share origin.
The production web app may call the local daemon, as the supplied build allowed its cloud origins.

edits.find: if(ni&&!ni.isSymbolicLink())throw Error(`${ti} already exists and is not a link. Remove it and try again.`);
edits.replace: if(ni&&!ni.isSymbolicLink()&&!(ni.isFile()&&ni.size<4096&&/Aux CLI\.app\/Contents\/MacOS\/aux-cli/.test(readFileSync(ti,`utf8`))))throw Error(`${ti} already exists and is not an Aux CLI link. Remove it and try again.`);
edits.why: Replace a wrapper script written by an earlier Aux CLI installer; refuse anything else.
